metadata.denominators: pool_total = non-fresh resolved rows; target_total = high joint drift old rows; seats_total = chosen seats; old_seats = reserved_count + neutral_backfill_count; random_expectation_total = old_seats * target_total / pool_total; mask_lost = masks_total - mask_seats
metadata.dense_control_note: A budget equal to the canvas is a dense full-selection control: every canvas row is selected, coverage is 100% by construction, and fixed edit-seat concepts do not apply. Only the hard_noedit dense row is reported for that budget.
